_comment: Common floor for all seven repositories. READ BY TYPESCRIPT 6 AND BY TYPESCRIPT 7.
RULE 1 — strict intersection. This file contains only options that are valid in
BOTH compilers. Any option specific to one version goes down into the file that
Notably ABSENT and forbidden here: stableTypeOrdering (TS 7: true and cannot be
turned off), baseUrl, target es5, downlevelIteration, moduleResolution node10,
RULE 2 — no path-bearing option. Relative paths in an extended tsconfig resolve
FROM THE FILE THEY ARE WRITTEN IN, i.e. from node_modules/@arthome/tooling/tsconfig/.
So these are absent: include, exclude, files, outDir, rootDir, declarationDir,
paths, typeRoots. They belong to the repository's own tsconfig.json.
The gate that proves rule 1: tools/dts-check extends this file and is type-checked
under both compilers. See architecture/code-conventions.md sections 4.4.1 to 4.4.3.
